svg.title: Graph of displacement against time for an oscillator released from rest at the same displacement x0 with three kinds of damping. Light damping: the curve keeps oscillating either side of zero displacement, with the amplitude getting smaller each cycle. Critical damping: the curve falls smoothly to zero displacement and stays there, without crossing zero, in the shortest time. Heavy damping: the curve also never crosses zero but falls much more slowly and is still clearly above zero at the end of the graph.
